signature.name: VTask.pi
signature.type: {κ : Type u_5} -> {π : κ → Type u_6} -> [(i : κ) → Lattice (π i)] -> (s : Set κ) -> (L : (i : κ) → Sublattice (π i)) -> Sublattice ((i : κ) → π i)

conventions.statement: VTask.pi ∅ L equals the top sublattice ⊤ of (i : κ) → π i, because no index is controlled.
conventions.note: Boundary: empty controlling set means no constraint on any coordinate.

conventions.statement: VTask.pi Set.univ L is the full product of the sublattices L i, constraining every coordinate.
conventions.note: Boundary: universal controlling set enforces membership in L i for all i.

conventions.point: L i = ⊥ for some i ∈ s with s = Set.univ
conventions.statement: VTask.pi Set.univ L = ⊥ whenever L i = ⊥ for some index i.
conventions.note: Follows from pi_univ_eq_bot; a single collapsed fiber forces the product to collapse.

facts.statement: ∀ (κ : Type) (π : κ → Type) [inst : (i : κ) → Lattice (π i)] (L : (i : κ) → Sublattice (π i)), VTask.pi ∅ L = ⊤

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (κ : Type) (π : κ → Type) [inst : (i : κ) → Lattice (π i)] (L : (i : κ) → Sublattice (π i)) (i : κ), L i = ⊥ → VTask.pi Set.univ L = ⊥

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (κ : Type) (π : κ → Type) [inst : (i : κ) → Lattice (π i)] (s : Set κ) (L L' : (i : κ) → Sublattice (π i)), (∀ i ∈ s, L i ≤ L' i) → VTask.pi s L ≤ VTask.pi s L'

facts.statement: ∀ (κ : Type) (π : κ → Type) [inst : (i : κ) → Lattice (π i)] (s t : Set κ) (L : (i : κ) → Sublattice (π i)), s ⊆ t → VTask.pi t L ≤ VTask.pi s L

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (κ : Type) (π : κ → Type) [inst : (i : κ) → Lattice (π i)] (s : Set κ) (L : (i : κ) → Sublattice (π i)) (M : Sublattice ((i : κ) → π i)), M ≤ VTask.pi s L ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, M ≤ Sublattice.comap (Pi.evalLatticeHom i) (L i)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (κ : Type) (π : κ → Type) [inst : (i : κ) → Lattice (π i)] (L : (i : κ) → Sublattice (π i)) (f g : (i : κ) → π i), f ∈ VTask.pi Set.univ L → g ∈ VTask.pi Set.univ L → f ⊔ g ∈ VTask.pi Set.univ L

facts.statement: ¬ (fun _ : Fin 1 => (⊤ : Bool)) ∈ VTask.pi Set.univ (fun _ : Fin 1 => (⊥ : Sublattice Bool))
